paths.name: expo-notifications
paths.message: Schedule through `apps/mobile/lib/notification-scheduler.ts` instead. Every pending notification competes for a platform budget the planner sizes (PLATFORM_NOTIFICATION_BUDGET), and one scheduled outside it is invisible to that accounting — on iOS it silently pushes a real reminder past the 64-request ceiling. If you genuinely need a second call site, add it to the override in .oxlintrc.json deliberately.
